messages.subject: Scaling x axis when the x axis is character vector
parts: I have scatter plot ( character vs numeric), and I want to show some some of the data not all. I am wondering if there is any way to scale the x-axis in ggplot.

messages.author: 56aba7f8b1fa173f
messages.subject: Re: Scaling x axis when the x axis is character vector
parts:
you can try to use the scale_x_continuous() to scale the x-axis. 
ex. scale_x_continuous(breaks=data$sample, labels=factor(data#sample)
